inputs.dem_height_datum: NAVD88 orthometric metres, as USGS states for 3DEP seamless; GEOID18 (world.terrain.geoid18) takes them to the NAD83(2011) ellipsoid
inputs.geoid_height_datum: metres from the NAD83(2011) ellipsoid up to the NAVD88 surface: an ellipsoid height is h = H + N, H a NAVD88 height and N this value

inputs.ground_height_datum: NAVD88 orthometric metres, as USGS states for every 3DEP DEM (the GeoTIFF's CRS has no vertical part); GEOID18 (world.terrain.geoid18) takes them to the NAD83(2011) ellipsoid
inputs.surface_height_datum: NAVD88 orthometric metres, as the 3DEP 1 m DEM's: the EPT's srs states no vertical datum, so it was measured -- 823,384 class-2 returns over cs-downtown sit 0.000 m (median, IQR 0.028 m) from the DEM's cells (2026-11-01). GEOID18 (world.terrain.geoid18) takes them to the NAD83(2011) ellipsoid

surface.height_datum: NAD83(2011) ellipsoid metres: h = H + N, H the highest of the 1 m lidar surface and every 1 m DEM file (NAVD88) in the cell holding the point and N GEOID18's, bilinear; used as WGS84 ellipsoid metres, about 1 m off in CONUS, not corrected

terrain.height_datum: NAD83(2011) ellipsoid metres: h = H + N, H the 3DEP DEM's NAVD88 height and N GEOID18's, each sampled bilinearly; used as WGS84 ellipsoid metres, about 1 m off in CONUS, not corrected

assumptions: Sites are the scenario's declared points, copied from the run's sinks: a home as its flight resolved it, a GCS as the C2 environment declared it.
Heights are above the WGS84 ellipsoid; an agl home is its declared height over the terrain the flight sampled under it.
A GCS is declared above the ellipsoid and no kernel samples the ground under it, so its terrain_height_m is null.
Each site has one row, at the grid's first epoch; sites do not move during a run.
No site declares a camera yet; C-UAS sites and cameras arrive with GEN-377.
semantic_metadata.attribution: Foundation C-UAS simulation (intelpayloads/dataforge-plugin-foundation), completed-run contract dataforge.completed-simulation-run/1 with a dataforge.uas-sites/1 artifact (GEN-355). SIMULATED, not observed: the scenario's declared sites. site_kind is home, gcs or cuas_site; drone is set on a home, jammer (emitter:foundation:<id>, or null) on a cuas_site. declared_height_m is m in declared_height_reference (hae or agl); terrain_height_m is m above the ellipsoid. gcs_eirp_w (W), gcs_frequency_hz (Hz) and gcs_min_elevation_deg (deg, the horizon mask) are set on a gcs only. camera_hfov_deg (deg, the widest horizontal field of view) and camera_width_px / camera_height_px (pixels) are all set on a gcs or cuas_site with a camera and all null otherwise
semantic_metadata.height_datum: height_m is the site's height above the WGS84 ellipsoid: a hae site as the scenario declared it, an agl site as its declared height over the region's NAVD88 DEM taken to NAD83(2011) ellipsoid metres by GEOID18, treated as WGS84 (about 1 m apart in CONUS, not corrected)

height_m.meaning: the site's height above the WGS84 ellipsoid

gcs_eirp_w.meaning: the GCS uplink EIRP; on a gcs only, null on other kinds

camera_hfov_deg.meaning: the EO camera's widest horizontal field of view, in (0, 180); on a gcs or cuas_site with a camera, null otherwise

camera_width_px.meaning: the camera's width in pixels, positive; on a gcs or cuas_site with a camera, null otherwise

camera_height_px.meaning: the camera's height in pixels, positive; on a gcs or cuas_site with a camera, null otherwise

gcs_frequency_hz.meaning: the C2 carrier; on a gcs only

terrain_height_m.meaning: the terrain under the site, as the flight sampled it under its home; for an agl site, height_m = terrain_height_m + declared_height_m; null on a gcs, which is declared above the ellipsoid and whose ground no kernel samples

declared_height_m.meaning: the height as the scenario declared it, in declared_height_reference

gcs_min_elevation_deg.meaning: the GCS horizon mask; null while the GCS path has none (GEN-373)

semantic_metadata.valid_time_basis: the grid's first epoch on the run's UTC time grid, an ISO-8601 instant with its offset
